# Podbean
> Podbean is a podcast hosting, distribution, monetization, and audience growth platform for creators, businesses, and enterprises.

Podbean provides tools to start, publish, promote, and monetize podcasts, including hosting, analytics, live streaming, AI-powered production features, advertising, listener subscriptions, mobile apps, and enterprise private podcasting.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://www.podbean.com/): Main overview of Podbean podcast hosting, monetization, AI tools, and growth features.
- [Start a Podcast](https://www.podbean.com/start-podcast): Introductory page for launching a podcast with Podbean hosting and publishing tools.
- [Podcast Hosting Pricing](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-hosting-pricing): Pricing plans for podcast hosting, monetization, and advanced creator features.
- [Podcast Statistics](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-stats): Overview of analytics, audience insights, and podcast performance tracking features.
- [Enterprise Podcast Solution](https://www.podbean.com/enterprise/enterprise-podcast-solution): Private and enterprise podcasting solution for internal communications, training, and secure audio distribution.

## AI Tools
- [Podbean AI](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-ai): AI-enhanced audio quality and content generation tools for podcast creators.
- [AI Podcast Recorder](https://www.podbean.com/audio-recorder): Browser-based and mobile-friendly audio recording tool for podcast creation.
- [Podcast Recorder](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-recorder): Podcast recording app page covering recording, editing, and publishing workflows.
- [Apps Marketplace](https://apps.podbean.com/): Podbean app ecosystem for AI, monetization, and podcast workflow extensions.

## Monetization
- [PodAds](https://podads.podbean.com/): Dynamic ad insertion and podcast advertising management platform for creators and networks.
- [Advertisers](https://sponsorship.podbean.com/): Sponsorship and advertiser-facing portal for podcast campaign opportunities on Podbean.
- [Monetization Overview](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-hosting-features): Feature overview including monetization, distribution, and audience growth capabilities.
- [Apple Podcasts Subscriptions](https://help.podbean.com/support/solutions/articles/25000019599): Help article for enabling Apple Podcasts paid subscriptions with Podbean.
- [Fan Club](https://help.podbean.com/support/solutions/articles/25000019597): Help documentation for listener support and subscription-based monetization features.

## Apps & Listening
- [Podcast App](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-app-iphone-android-mobile): Podbean listener app for discovering, following, and playing podcasts on mobile.
- [iPhone Podcast App](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-app-iphone-android-mobile): iOS listening app page with playback, discovery, and subscription features.
- [Android Podcast App](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-app-iphone-android-mobile): Android listening app page for podcast playback and audience engagement.
- [Live Stream Podcasting](https://www.podbean.com/live-stream): Live audio streaming platform for podcasters to broadcast and interact with listeners.

## Distribution & Publishing
- [Submit Podcast](https://www.podbean.com/site/submitPodcast): Submit and distribute podcast feeds for discovery and listening platforms.
- [Podcast Hosting Features](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-hosting-features): Publishing, hosting, website, distribution, and monetization feature overview.
- [Private Podcasting](https://www.podbean.com/site/startPodcast/privatePodcast): Private podcast hosting for secure member, team, or customer-only audio distribution.
- [Podcast Website Features](https://www.podbean.com/podcast-hosting-features): Overview of customizable podcast websites included with hosting plans.

## Developer & Integrations
- [Developer Platform](https://developers.podbean.com/): API and developer resources for building podcast apps and integrations with Podbean.
- [Apps Marketplace](https://apps.podbean.com/): Integration directory for extending Podbean workflows and podcast functionality.
- [Help Center](https://help.podbean.com/support/home): Central support portal with setup guides, troubleshooting, and feature documentation.

## Enterprise & Business
- [Enterprise Podcast Solution](https://www.podbean.com/enterprise/enterprise-podcast-solution): Enterprise-grade private podcasting for communications, onboarding, and training.
- [Private Podcast Hosting](https://www.podbean.com/site/startPodcast/privatePodcast): Secure podcast delivery for organizations, teams, and restricted audiences.
- [Business Podcasts](https://www.podbean.com/business-podcasts): Business podcast category and discovery page for professional and company-focused shows.

## Specialized Use Cases
- [Christian Podcasting](https://www.podbean.com/christian-podcasting): Podcast hosting and monetization tools tailored for churches and Christian creators.
- [Sermon Audio](https://www.podbean.com/sermon-audio): Sermon and ministry audio publishing solution for churches and faith-based organizations.
- [Education Podcasts](https://www.podbean.com/education-podcasts): Education podcast category page for learning-focused podcast discovery.
- [Technology Podcasts](https://www.podbean.com/technology-podcasts): Technology podcast category page for tech-focused show discovery.

## Support & Resources
- [Help Center Home](https://help.podbean.com/support/home): Main support hub for Podbean product documentation and customer assistance.
- [Knowledge Base](https://help.podbean.com/support/solutions): Browse support articles for hosting, monetization, apps, and distribution.
- [Contact Support](https://help.podbean.com/support/tickets/new): Submit a support request for Podbean account and product issues.
- [Community](https://help.podbean.com/support/discussions): Community discussions for Podbean users, questions, and product feedback.
